clue.text: Got fed up with being derided

definitions.meaning: ate up greedily, wolfed down a meal

explanation.surface: Someone grew weary of being mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoff is both to wolf down food and to jeer at someone, so the past tense covers eating up and mocking.

clue.text: Where commuters could be left standing

definitions.text: Where commuters could be left standing

parts.words: Where commuters could be left standing
parts.note: sounds like a crowded train with no seats, but it is the stop where a train departs without the passengers on the platform

explanation.definitionFit: A railway stop is where commuters wait, and where they are left behind if the train pulls out without them.

clue.text: Only asses crush oranges

indicators.note: crushing fruit mashes it up, so the letters of the fruit word are pulped into a new order

explanation.surface: A claim that only donkeys squash citrus fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crush' turns ORANGES into the plural of a wild Asian ass; 'Only' merely joins the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: An onager is a wild ass of central Asia, so the plural names a group of such animals.

clue.text: Warships must be swift

explanation.surface: Naval vessels need to be fast.
explanation.definitionFit: A navy's collection of ships is a fleet, and fleet as an adjective means fast-moving.

clue.text: Guide leading detective to the parsonage

parts.note: DI, Detective Inspector, is a senior police detective
a rectory is the house of a parish priest

explanation.surface: Instructions for taking a senior police officer to the vicar's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A directory is a reference book that guides you to names and addresses.

clue.text: The nature of infects the teller." (A and C)

definitions.text: The nature of infects the teller." (A and C)

parts.words: The nature of infects the teller." (A and C)
parts.note: a gap-fill quotation from Shakespeare's Antony and Cleopatra (A and C): the missing two words name the tidings that taint the messenger

explanation.walkthrough: The gap after 'of' is the answer; Cleopatra lashes out at the messenger who brings word of Antony's marriage, and he replies with this line.
explanation.definitionFit: In the play, unwelcome tidings make the listener hate whoever delivers them, the line that gave rise to 'don't shoot the messenger'.

clue.text: Fish is fab

definitions.meaning: a European flatfish related to the turbot
slang for excellent, short for brilliant

explanation.surface: Someone enthuses that fish is wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: Brill is a flatfish, and also British slang clipped from brilliant, meaning terrific.

clue.text: Deviant man taking the plunge

parts.note: one who plunges into water is a diver
gent is short for gentleman

explanation.surface: An odd fellow decides to jump into the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Divergent means departing from the norm, the same idea as deviant.

clue.text: He turns out to be the eastern champion

parts.note: a victor is a winner, a champion

explanation.surface: A fighter who goes out of the ring turns out to be the winner from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: An evictor is a person who puts tenants out of their home.

clue.text: Get a move on and leave home

definitions.meaning: walk briskly, step up the pace
go out of the house for a while

explanation.surface: Hurry up and go out.
explanation.definitionFit: To step out is both to walk quickly and to go out of doors, often for an evening.

clue.text: A friend backs rugby teams playing for love alone

parts.note: mate is British slang for a friend

indicators.note: backs means the two letters face the other way, read backwards behind the friend

parts.note: RU stands for Rugby Union, the code played by fifteen-a-side teams

explanation.surface: A pal supports rugby sides who play without pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backs' turns RU into UR. 'backs' poses as a rugby position, and 'love' as tennis nil, but 'for love' means unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-professional plays without payment, purely for the enjoyment of the game.

clue.text: Bill is warbling well

definitions.meaning: singing in good form, with the voice at its best

explanation.surface: A man named Bill sings beautifully.
explanation.definitionFit: An invoice is a demand for payment, and a singer 'in voice' is performing at full vocal strength.

clue.text: All the same, I'd let Cain go free

indicators.note: letting someone go free releases them, so these letters are set loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: Nevertheless, a forgiving speaker would release the first murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that match in every detail are exactly alike.

clue.text: Proportional representation

parts.note: looks like the electoral system, but read literally it is a way of expressing one quantity relative to another

explanation.definitionFit: A figure such as 3:1 represents the proportion between two amounts.

clue.text: Nosey recruit joins US space agency

indicators.note: joins means the recruit's letter is attached at the end of the agency

parts.note: NASA, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration
L for learner, a novice or new recruit

explanation.surface: An inquisitive newcomer signs up with NASA.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasal means relating to the nose, a playful sense of nosey.

clue.text: Jump to it to appear smart

explanation.surface: Hurry and make sure you are well turned out.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a command to hurry up, and literally it means to seem neat and elegant.

clue.text: Running round without a break

explanation.surface: Jogging a circuit with no rest.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both constantly busy and consecutively, as in three wins in a row.

clue.text: Treasury where the USSR contrived to hoard gold

indicators.note: hoarding means storing away, so the shuffled letters hold the gold symbol inside them
contrived means artificially arranged, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A Cold War tale of the Soviet Union stockpiling bullion in its exchequer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' turns THE USSR into THESSUR-type order; 'to hoard' puts AU inside, giving THES-AU-RUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is literally a treasure-house of words; the Greek root means store of riches.

clue.text: First master has to use the keyboard, for example

parts.note: a pro is an expert, a master of the craft
typing is one way of using a keyboard

explanation.surface: A new boss must learn typing, say.
explanation.definitionFit: A prototype is the first model of something, from which later versions are made.

clue.text: Maybe a hard-hearted sapper needs correction

indicators.note: something needing correction is wrong, so these letters must be put right in a new order

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils, placed at the centre of the fodder

explanation.surface: Possibly a callous army engineer should be disciplined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs correction' rearranges SAPPER with H inside it into PERHAPS. A sapper is a military engineer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words express possibility without certainty.

clue.text: Up for sale, despite intermittent hesitation

parts.note: on-off describes something that stops and starts
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: Something is on the market though the seller keeps dithering.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods available to buy are being offered.

clue.text: Seaman without exercise has spill

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the sailor goes around the exercise

parts.note: tar is old slang for a sailor
PE, physical education

explanation.surface: A sailor who skips his workout knocks something over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means outside. 'spill' looks like a verb; it is a thin strip of wood or paper for lighting a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A taper is a slender candle or wick used for lighting, the same object as a spill.

clue.text: Making one's point by testing

definitions.meaning: trying out, as with a gun at a range

explanation.surface: Showing you are right by putting it to the test.
explanation.definitionFit: To prove is both to demonstrate a claim and to subject something to trial, as in a proving ground.

clue.text: About to pay the price for turning tail

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to treat someone is to pay for them

explanation.surface: Someone is about to suffer for running away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pay the price for' suggests punishment but means buying for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning tail is withdrawing from danger, which is what an army in retreat does.

clue.text: Castles in the air

definitions.meaning: black birds of the crow family seen flying

explanation.surface: Daydreams of grand fortresses.
explanation.definitionFit: Rooks are the chess pieces shaped like towers and also crows that flock overhead.

clue.text: Exhausted after frolicking in the garden

explanation.surface: Tired after a game outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Spent or finished is one sense, and having played outdoors is the literal one.

clue.text: Pummel the dough

definitions.meaning: a soft moist mixture like pastry

explanation.surface: Knead the bread mixture.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone a pasting is to beat them, and a soft spreadable mix is also called a paste.

clue.text: Follow directions and bring a case

parts.note: E and N, east and north, are compass directions
to sue is to bring a lawsuit

explanation.surface: Obey instructions and take someone to court.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to come after as a result.

clue.text: A phrase uttered in public riots

indicators.note: uttered means spoken, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: the two words said together

explanation.surface: Some words shouted during street disturbances.
explanation.definitionFit: An affray is a fight in a public place disturbing the peace, a legal term for brawling.

clue.text: Stay to see psychic powers in religious ceremony

indicators.note: in means the powers sit inside the ceremony

parts.note: a rite is a solemn ritual
ESP, extrasensory perception

explanation.surface: A medium checks clairvoyance at a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stay' is the noun, as in a stay of execution: a reprieve.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay of execution is a reprieve, a temporary break or delay.

clue.text: Compunction felt by a lightweight

definitions.meaning: an old apothecaries' weight of twenty grains

explanation.surface: A small person feels guilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A scruple is both a moral hesitation and a tiny unit of apothecaries' weight.

clue.text: Skill needed to make toboggan by Tuesday

parts.note: a sleigh is a sledge

explanation.surface: Craftsmanship is required to build a sledge by Tuesday.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight means dexterity, as in sleight of hand.
